report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency, but current telemetry is largely healthy: gateway error_rate 0.0012, p95 74ms, INFO 200 logs; order checkout span OK at 1350ms. Only a single gateway trace shows an ERROR calling order, and order shows retained heap after GC (WARN x7, 300MB). Insufficient evidence to bound a root cause; hand off.
missing_evidence: Sustained error-rate/latency time series for gateway and order over the alert window
Trace-level error detail for the gateway 'call order' ERROR span (error message/status code)
Order-side dependency latency breakdown (inventory, payment, postgresql)
Memory-retention trend over time for order to distinguish leak from steady state
